name: Anaba minotaurs
description: A spiritual and wise minotaur tribe on Ulgrotha, living in the Kher Ridge of the Koskun Mountains.

timeline.summary: Taysir enslaved the Anaba and summoned an earthquake against Feroz, killing many Anaba and destroying the pictoglyph caves.
timeline.quote: Taysir enslaved the Anaba, and many of them were killed when Taysir summoned an earthquake against Feroz, which also destroyed the pictoglyph caves.
